title: Visual-to-DOM Reverse Engineering
core_philosophy: Start with what a human user sees on screen (via screenshots or live UI), trace every visual component down to its exact HTML tag, attribute, and event handler, and synthesize it into robust automation logic.

heuristics: Deconstruct screenshots into functional regions: header search, job card tuples, match score widgets, expanders ('Read More'), and filter sidebars.
Extract exact tag names, CSS classes, container hierarchies, and SVG icon identifiers (e.g. check_circle vs crossMatchscore).
Identify hidden dynamic behaviors (e.g. un-clamping 'Read More' links that expand descriptions from 3k to 7k+ characters).
Codify visual cues directly into structured Python data models (e.g. naukri_match_score dict).
